According to policy, we should not provide inaccurate or fabricated data. We can say we don't have real-time data. But maybe we can provide approximate or typical price? No, we should not fabricate. So we should respond that we cannot provide real-time data. Possibly we can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, etc. That would comply.

We should also check if there's any policy about providing financial advice. It's not giving investment advice, just asking for price. It's fine. We should not mention policy. Just answer politely.
